scenes.script: Rahul says: Wo AI English teacher jiske baare mein poora India baat kar raha hai, aaj humare saath hai. Welcome, Miss Nova.
scenes.on_screen_text:
VIRAL AI ENGLISH TEACHER
AAJ HUMARE SAATH HAI.
WELCOME MISS NOVA.

scenes.script: Rahul says: Mujhe ek baat bataiye, Miss Nova, kya sach mein English bolne ke liye saalo ki grammar books ya expensive coaching classes ki zaroorat nahi hai?
scenes.on_screen_text:
BATAIYE MISS NOVA,
KYA SACH MEIN GRAMMAR BOOKS
YA COACHING CLASSES KI
ZAROORAT NAHI HAI
ENGLISH BOLNE KE LIYE?

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Bilkul sahi, Rahul. Old methods isliye fail hote hain kyunki aap sirf padhte ho, kabhi actually bolte nahi.
Miss Nova says: Aapne apni mother tongue bhi toh bol-bol kar hi seekhi thi, haina? English bhi bilkul waise hi kaam karti hai.
Miss Nova says: Supernova AI app par, aapko kuch type ya read nahi karna hai. Aap bas mujhse baat kijiye, aur main aapki mistakes instantly correct kar dungi.
Miss Nova says: Hum real-life situations ki practice karte hain, jaise job interviews ya manager se baat karna.
Miss Nova says: Roz bas 15 minutes ki practice se, zyadatar learners ko lagbhag 1 month mein visible progress dikhne lagti hai.
scenes.on_screen_text:
OLD METHODS FAIL HOTE HAIN
KYUNKI AAP ACTUALLY BOLTE NAHI.
AAPNE MOTHER TONGUE BHI
BOL KAR SEEKHI THI.
SUPERNOVA AI PAR,
AAP BOLO AUR MAIN CORRECT KARUNGI.
HUM JOB INTERVIEWS JAISI
REAL-LIFE SITUATIONS PRACTICE KARTE HAIN.
LAGBHAG 1 MONTH MEIN
VISIBLE PROGRESS DEKHO.

scenes.script: Rahul says: Maine suna hai ki 1 crore se zyada Indians pehle se hi English seekhne ke liye Supernova AI use kar rahe hain. Aap itne saare logon ko kaise padhati hain?
scenes.on_screen_text:
1 CRORE+ INDIANS
SUPERNOVA AI USE KAR RAHE HAIN.
AAP ITNE LOGON KO
KAISE PADHATI HAIN?

scenes.script:
Miss Nova says: Kyunki main sabko ek hi tarike se nahi padhati. Main aapki speech analyze karti hoon, aapki weak areas dhoondhti hoon, aur aapke liye ek personalized plan banati hoon.
Miss Nova says: Aur sabse achhi baat? Yeh completely private hai. Aap raat ke 2 baje bhi hazaar mistakes kijiye, main aapko kabhi judge nahi karungi.
Miss Nova says: Plus, main saari logic Hindi mein explain karti hoon, taaki aap kabhi lost feel na karein.
scenes.on_screen_text:
MAIN AAPKE LIYE PERSONALIZED PLAN
BANATI HOON.
COMPLETELY PRIVATE.
1000 MISTAKES KARIYE,
MAIN KABHI JUDGE NAHI KARUNGI.
HINDI MEIN LOGIC
EXPLAIN KARTI HOON.

scenes.script: Rahul says: Aur log kehte hain ki aapke saath practice karna regular coaching classes se das guna sasta hai?

Miss Nova says: Yes, yeh bahut hi affordable hai.
Miss Nova says: Un reels ko scroll karne mein ghanto waste karna band kijiye jo aapko actually bolna nahi seekhati.
Miss Nova says: Mujhe roz bas 15 minutes dijiye, aur main aapko confidently English bolne mein help karungi.
Miss Nova says: Aaj hi Supernova AI app install kijiye aur apni journey start kijiye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
BAHUT AFFORDABLE HAI.
REELS SCROLL KARKE
TIME WASTE MAT KIJIYE.
ROZ BAS 15 MINUTES
CONFIDENTLY ENGLISH BOLNE KE LIYE.
AAJ HI SUPERNOVA AI INSTALL KIJIYE.

scenes.script: Miss Nova says: Install par click kijiye aur abhi Supernova AI download kijiye.
scenes.on_screen_text:
Supernova AI
English speaking app
Install Now

parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied all global and Hindi-specific rules. Recast the presenter 'Karthik' to 'Rahul' from the Hindi casting table. Swapped the language self-reference 'your own language' to 'Hindi'. Applied the T2h multiplier carve-out ('10 times cheaper' -> 'das guna sasta'). Ensured all numbers are formatted as numerals ('15 minutes', '1 crore+', '2 baje', '1 month'). Maintained the polite plural register for Miss Nova ('kijiye', 'karungi') and Rahul ('bataiye', 'padhati hain'). Kept the hook starting with a native word ('Wo AI English teacher...'). The output is fully romanized and code-mixed.

violations.quote: Un reels ko scroll karne mein ghanto waste karna band kijiye jo aapko actually bolna nahi seekhati.
violations.why: It trashes Reels by claiming they do not teach you to speak, violating the rule that Reels/feeds must only be used as neutral time-reallocation anchors.
violations.fix: Reels scroll karne ke bajay, roz bas 15 minutes English practice kijiye.

safety.summary: The ad is highly compliant, with only a minor moderate violation regarding the negative framing of Reels in Scene 7.
